# Trading Expo Africa

Trading Expo Africa is Africa's premier exhibition and conference for online trading, fintech and financial markets, organised by ProFX Media FZ-LLC.

## Event facts

- Dates: 19–20 February 2027 (two full days)
- Venue: Emperors Palace, Centre Court, 64 Jones Road, Kempton Park, Johannesburg, South Africa
- Organiser: ProFX Media FZ-LLC
- Contact: info@profxmedia.com
- Ticket pricing: to be announced
- Visitor, exhibitor and speaker scale numbers: to be announced

## Program highlights

- Exhibition floor: brokers, fintech companies, trading platforms, payment providers
- Two-day conference: keynotes, panels, workshops on trading strategy, platforms and risk
- Live trading contest across both days — staged by ProFX Media FZ-LLC, the official Guinness World Records™ title holders for the most participants in a trading competition
- Awards night: the Trading Expo Africa Awards, gala on the evening of 19 February 2027
- Networking: meetups, influencers, deal-making
